title: CmdPal: OAuth spec for extension toolkit

status.label: Waiting on author
status.detail: A current-head maintainer review requests moving OAuth work into the extension-process toolkit rather than the host broker. The author replied before the maintainer reiterated this request on September 25, but has not replied or pushed since; older draft suggestions are withheld pending a design revision.

next_action: Revalidate the specification and any retained findings after the author responds or pushes a revised design.

author_wait_evidence.author: zadjii-msft
author_wait_evidence.requested_evidence: Revise or respond to the requested extension-process toolkit OAuth design, leaving CmdPal.exe out of the OAuth implementation and introducing a palette-show API only if needed.
